messages:
harper (People Ops): quick follow-up from today's all-hands on the reorg + staffing roadmap. i'll answer short Qs here, please keep them concise.
kevin (CEO): short summary: focus hires on infra, runtime, and enterprise reliability for the next 6 months.
tara (Head of Eng): to add: consolidations are intended to reduce context-switching and clarify ownership, not to cut headcount. most moves will be role realignments.
ben (SWE): will this change our quarterly OKRs?
tara (Head of Eng): no wholesale OKR change. some owners will change; we'll publish owner mappings so teams know who to sync with.
zoe (Eng Manager): manager hiring 14 freeze or open?
kevin (CEO): manager hires are limited. hire managers only when the role clearly increases throughput (e.g., enables >2 squads) or is compliance-critical. otherwise prefer senior IC hires.
sanjay (VP Infra): infra & SRE reqs are prioritized to meet SLAs. please flag those with "sre-priority".
olivia (Recruiter): logistical note: "sre-priority" reqs -> post in ~48-72 hours; standard priorities -> 7-10 business days. always include two measurable success outcomes on the req.
harper (People Ops): preview of the headcount snapshot we'll publish tomorrow:
```
Q1 tactical: +10 (infra 5, runtime 3, reliability 2)
Q2 strategic: +14 (platform 6, enterprise 5, research 3)
Backfills: 7
```
ben (SWE): can teams bring in contractors during transitions? some teams need quick help for demos.
tara (Head of Eng): short-term contractors OK for experiments (<=3 months). long-term ownership should be full-time hires.
zoe (Eng Manager): will there be a public mapping doc so people can see where they land?
harper (People Ops): yes  we'll publish a mapping with flags: "retained", "open", "under-review" and a short rationale. internal mobility window will be 2 weeks after publication.
notices-bot: Reminder: all new hiring reqs must use the updated template by EOD Friday. link: https://redwood/internal/hiring-req
ben (SWE): any immediate changes to leveling or career ladders?
kevin (CEO): no immediate leveling changes. we'll communicate any ladder updates separately if needed.
harper (People Ops): thanks all  we'll compile this into an FAQ and pin it to the all-hands notes. DM me or @olivia for private follow-ups. :raised_hands:
